requirements: Actual Q3 is the clean single-parent metadata-only child of H3.
Before and after: exact HEAD, int, branch, Node, pnpm, owned TMPDIR, tracked status and source hashes.
Use an exclusive new output directory and owned process group; never overwrite earlier captures.
Preserve native JSON, raw log, exit code, failed assertions, genuine collection errors and skips.
Root checks native arithmetic, exact file roster and exit/success coherence; missing or malformed output never qualifies.
Classify each failure separately against actual clean int and candidate evidence. No future failure is preclassified.
Do not edit, rebuild, stage or commit in the candidate while its full run executes.
Write completed full evidence outside Q3, bound to Q3, so the measured final commit remains unchanged.
inheritedCaptureCaveats: Some launch, snapshot and malformed nested JSON exceptions can escape before result.json. Preserve all available artifacts and record an invalid capture explicitly.
